title: Bharat Last-Mile ID Level 1 JWT Claims Set
description: Structural constraints for the JWT Claims Set carried by an LMID Level 1 pass. The specification defines cross-field time and uniqueness constraints.

iss.description: Canonical bare domain name that identifies the issuer and anchors metadata and signing-key discovery.

iat.description: UTC time at which the issuer created the pass, encoded as a JWT NumericDate in seconds.

nbf.description: Earliest UTC time at which a verifier may accept the pass, encoded as a JWT NumericDate in seconds.

exp.description: UTC time at or after which a verifier must reject the pass, encoded as a JWT NumericDate in seconds.

jti.description: Issuer-unique opaque identifier for this pass instance, used for deduplication and status checks.

lmid.description: Versioned LMID claims that describe the holder, optional vehicle, destination, and deliveries.

v.description: Wire-format version of the LMID claims profile carried in this Level 1 pass, separate from capability levels.

holder.description: Minimal identity information for the delivery person presenting the pass.

vehicle.description: Optional vehicle information associated with this visit.

visit.description: Common destination and one or more delivery records covered by the pass.

name.description: Issuer-verified display name of the delivery person.

photo.description: Optional integrity-protected photograph reference for visual comparison by the verifier.

uri.description: Short-lived HTTPS URL from which an authorized verifier can retrieve the holder photograph.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the exact photograph bytes returned by uri.

registration.description: Vehicle registration mark as supplied and normalized by the issuer.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the vehicle registration authority.

provider.description: Provider identifier naming the place-ID system; readers ignore unsupported providers.

id.description: Provider-specific place identifier, limited to 256 characters for every provider; values must not be truncated to fit.

name.description: Human-readable name of the property or destination.

address.description: Required issuer-supplied address text for display and fallback matching.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the destination.

state.description: State or union territory name for the destination.

district.description: Administrative district name for the destination.

city.description: City, town, or locality name for the destination.

area.description: Neighbourhood, sector, layout, or local area name for the destination.

street.description: Street, road, lane, or access-road name for the destination.

landmark.description: Optional landmark that helps a human identify the destination.

postal_code.description: Postal routing code as text, including leading zeroes when present.

place_ids.description: Provider-qualified identifiers that help independently identify or reconcile the destination.

ref.description: Issuer-scoped tracking reference for this delivery, such as an AWB, order ID, delivery ID, or service ID.

building.description: Building, tower, house name, house number, or separately named structure for this delivery endpoint.

block.description: Block, phase, cluster, wing, or comparable subdivision for this delivery endpoint.

floor.description: Restricted floor or level identifier for this delivery endpoint.

unit.description: Restricted final endpoint identifier or customer-entered compound label, including comma-separated building and unit components.

place.description: Common gate-level society, community, complex, campus, or property data for the visit.

deliveries.description: One to thirty-two deliveries assigned to the holder for the common place.
